subject: AI & Agents
title: Your Role in Shaping AI's Future
description: One-minute skill: Your Role in Shaping AI's Future.

hook.text: You're not just a user of AI. You're a citizen in a society being reshaped by it.

buildup.text: Voting, advocacy, consumer choices, and public discourse all shape how AI develops.

discovery.text: Demanding transparency, fairness, and accountability from AI companies drives real change.

twist.text: Opting out isn't realistic — AI is embedded in too many systems. Informed engagement is key.

climax.text: The decisions made in the next decade will shape AI governance for a century.

punchline.text: AI's future isn't written by engineers alone. It's written by all of us.

quiz.question: How can individuals shape the future of AI?
options: Through voting, advocacy, and demanding accountability

details.summary: Everyone has a role in shaping how AI develops — through how they use it, what they demand from companies, and how they engage with governance. Informed citizens are the ultimate check on AI power.
details.whyItMatters: AI development is not just a technical issue. Public engagement, consumer choices, and civic participation determine whether AI serves broad human flourishing or narrow interests.
takeaways: Consumer choices and feedback directly influence AI development
Civic engagement shapes AI regulation and governance
Informed citizens are the ultimate safeguard against AI misuse

faq.question: How can ordinary people influence AI development?
faq.answer: By choosing products from responsible companies, providing feedback, supporting AI regulation, learning about AI issues, and participating in public consultations on technology governance.

faq.question: Do consumer choices really affect how AI companies behave?
faq.answer: Yes. Public backlash has led companies to pause facial recognition sales, improve content moderation, and adopt voluntary safety commitments. Sustained pressure drives meaningful change.
